vdBlurbOverpass: Laser, lifti igenda, n'inzira yo hejuru mbere y'ibendera.
vdBlurbFinals: Utusanduku dutatu, irembo rya laser, n'umusumeno ku murongo wa nyuma.
staffIntro: Andika ijambo ry'ibanga ry'abakozi. Iki gikoresho kiguma gifunguye kugeza usohoka. Urufunguzo rwa TechWorks ni urundi.
staffDeskIntro: Ntabwo ari ikarita y'ishuri. Fungura urufunguzo rwa TechWorks Cloud. Hash iri muri iki kiganiro. Funga ikiganiro ukinjire.
staffPinBody: PIN ishyirwa muri TechWorks, ntabwo iri kuri iki Chromebook. Umunyeshuri ahitamo izina, hanyuma akandika kode na PIN.
staffKeyHint: Omeka urufunguzo rwa Cloud. Kubika bwa mbere bifata urugi niba ntawe urufashe.
finePrintGrown: KuliNet ni porogaramu z'uburezi z'ubuntu umwarimu yakoreye abanyeshuri ba tekinoloji muri Solvay Middle School (imyaka 6–8) i Solvay, New York. Uru rupapuro rusobanura uwaba iki, gushimira, amakuru y'abanyeshuri n'uko waduhamagara.
fineMadeKid: Bwana Kulibert n'imashini ze zafashije zakoze izi porogaramu ku ishuri ryacu. Ni ubuntu kandi nta muntu ugurisha ikintu hano.
fineNotTheirsKid: Bertopia ni umukino wo kubaka amabuye, ariko si Minecraft cyangwa Roblox. Ntabwo dufitanye isano n'iyi mikino. Berty ni umuntu wacu.
finePrivacyKid: Ukoresha izina ry'ibanga, ntabwo ari izina ryawe nyaryo. Ntukandike izina ryawe, aderesi, telefoni cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga. Ni Bwana Kulibert wenyine uzi izina ryawe.
fineSchoolKid: Izi porogaramu ni iz'ishuri. Uzikoreshe ku kazi k'ishuri kandi ube mwiza.
fineProgressKid: Turakomeza kubaka no gukosora izi porogaramu, rero rimwe na rimwe ikintu kirangirika. Niba hari ikitaramutse, bwira Bwana Kulibert.
fineCreationsKid: Ibyo ukora ni ibyawe. Ishuri rirabibona kandi rikosore, ukaba wishimwa n'izina ryawe ry'ibanga.
fineKindKid: Sangira gusa ibintu byiza, bikwiriye ishuri kandi byakozwe nawe cyangwa n'ishuri.
fineQuestionsKid: Ibibazo cyangwa impungenge? Vugana na Bwana Kulibert cyangwa umuntu mukuru wizeye.

Ikirahure cy'uwatsinze kivuga ururimi rwawe. Bivugwa rimwe. Icyumba cy'itangira kigira neza ku gatsiko. Ibikubiyemo byo guhagarara bivuga ururimi rwawe.
